records.key: Analyze plaque images with existing matching masks instead of generating new plaque masks.
records.source: Analyze plaque images with existing matching masks instead of generating new plaque masks.
records.translation: Greindu skellumyndir með fyrirliggjandi samsvarandi grímum í stað þess að búa til nýjar skellugrímur.

records.key: Apply a selected segmentation checkpoint to new images and inspect masks before measuring objects.
records.source: Apply a selected segmentation checkpoint to new images and inspect masks before measuring objects.
records.translation: Beittu völdum vistuðum hlutunarlíkanspunkti á nýjar myndir og skoðaðu grímurnar áður en hlutir eru mældir.

records.key: Check ParaScape and data setup
records.source: Check ParaScape and data setup
records.translation: Athuga ParaScape og uppsetningu gagna

records.key: Choose the assay question to identify its image inputs, required measurements and dedicated analysis route.
records.source: Choose the assay question to identify its image inputs, required measurements and dedicated analysis route.
records.translation: Veldu spurningu greiningarprófsins til að finna inntaksmyndir þess, nauðsynlegar mælingar og viðeigandi greiningarleið.

records.key: Choose the data you have, then narrow down the task to find a software protocol.
records.source: Choose the data you have, then narrow down the task to find a software protocol.
records.translation: Veldu gögnin sem þú hefur og þrengdu síðan verkefnið til að finna verklagsleiðbeiningar fyrir hugbúnaðinn.

records.key: Choose the microscope export or existing project layout so its image and field metadata can be reviewed.
records.source: Choose the microscope export or existing project layout so its image and field metadata can be reviewed.
records.translation: Veldu útflutning smásjárinnar eða skipulag fyrirliggjandi verkefnis svo hægt sé að fara yfir lýsigögn mynda og myndsviða.

records.key: Choose the sequencing-read layout and supply the matching experimental barcode references.
records.source: Choose the sequencing-read layout and supply the matching experimental barcode references.
records.translation: Veldu fyrirkomulag raðgreiningarlestra og gefðu upp samsvarandi viðmið fyrir strikamerki tilraunarinnar.

records.key: Choose whether object labels are already reviewed or must be defined before training a feature-based classifier.
records.source: Choose whether object labels are already reviewed or must be defined before training a feature-based classifier.
records.translation: Veldu hvort flokkamerkingar hluta hafi þegar verið yfirfarnar eða þurfi að skilgreina þær áður en eiginleikaflokkari er þjálfaður.

records.key: Combine imaging phenotypes with sequencing barcodes or optical barcode identities using the appropriate screening workflow.
records.source: Combine imaging phenotypes with sequencing barcodes or optical barcode identities using the appropriate screening workflow.
records.translation: Sameinaðu myndgreindar svipgerðir við raðgreiningarstrikamerki eða auðkenni sjónrænna strikamerkja með viðeigandi skimunarferli.

records.key: Compare segmentation predictions, evaluate independent reference masks or inspect saved training runs.
records.source: Compare segmentation predictions, evaluate independent reference masks or inspect saved training runs.
records.translation: Berðu saman spár hlutunar, mettu óháðar viðmiðunargrímur eða skoðaðu vistaðar þjálfunarkeyrslur.

records.key: Connect matching spatial identities and measured phenotypes before comparing groups or exporting data.
records.source: Connect matching spatial identities and measured phenotypes before comparing groups or exporting data.
records.translation: Tengdu samsvarandi rúmfræðileg auðkenni og mældar svipgerðir áður en hópar eru bornir saman eða gögn flutt út.

records.key: Create and review image-mask pairs before training a segmentation model and testing separate fields.
records.source: Create and review image-mask pairs before training a segmentation model and testing separate fields.
records.translation: Búðu til og yfirfarðu mynd- og grímupör áður en hlutunarlíkan er þjálfað og prófað á aðskildum myndsviðum.

records.key: Create object masks by applying a segmentation model or working interactively on individual images.
records.source: Create object masks by applying a segmentation model or working interactively on individual images.
records.translation: Búðu til grímur hluta með hlutunarlíkani eða með gagnvirkri vinnu á einstökum myndum.

records.key: Create object-image labels or compare independent annotations and review disagreements.
records.source: Create object-image labels or compare independent annotations and review disagreements.
records.translation: Búðu til flokkamerkingar fyrir myndir hluta eða berðu saman óháðar merkingar og farðu yfir ágreining.

records.key: Follow objects across ordered two-dimensional frames with explicit frame timing and reviewed track links.
records.source: Follow objects across ordered two-dimensional frames with explicit frame timing and reviewed track links.
records.translation: Fylgdu hlutum í gegnum raðaða tvívíða myndramma með skýrum rammatímum og yfirförnum rakningartengingum.

records.key: High content
records.source: High content
records.translation: Mikið myndmagn

records.key: Import external masks or use an existing merged project, then measure objects without unnecessary new segmentation.
records.source: Import external masks or use an existing merged project, then measure objects without unnecessary new segmentation.
records.translation: Flyttu inn ytri grímur eða notaðu fyrirliggjandi sameinað verkefni og mældu síðan hlutina án óþarfrar nýrrar hlutunar.

records.key: Inspect existing projects and recorded runs, manage execution or export documented results.
records.source: Inspect existing projects and recorded runs, manage execution or export documented results.
records.translation: Skoðaðu fyrirliggjandi verkefni og skráðar keyrslur, stýrðu keyrslu eða flyttu út skráðar niðurstöður.

records.key: Inspect feature tables, discover candidate phenotypes, define gated populations or investigate unusual objects.
records.source: Inspect feature tables, discover candidate phenotypes, define gated populations or investigate unusual objects.
records.translation: Skoðaðu eiginleikatöflur, finndu mögulegar svipgerðir, skilgreindu hópa með hliðum eða rannsakaðu óvenjulega hluti.

records.key: Inspect image organization or correct existing masks interactively before further analysis.
records.source: Inspect image organization or correct existing masks interactively before further analysis.
records.translation: Skoðaðu skipulag mynda eða leiðréttu fyrirliggjandi grímur gagnvirkt áður en greiningu er haldið áfram.

records.key: Low content
records.source: Low content
records.translation: Lítið myndmagn

records.key: Match barcode counts to phenotype scores or direct measured responses before screening regression.
records.source: Match barcode counts to phenotype scores or direct measured responses before screening regression.
records.translation: Tengdu talningar strikamerkja við svipgerðarstig eða beint mæld svör fyrir skimunaraðhvarf.

records.key:
ParaScape is an alpha application for exploring the Toxoplasma knowledge map. Features and results may change. It opens in a separate window.

The latest compatible stable ParaScape release is installed from PyPI. When gene data is missing, ParaScape asks before downloading it on first open. Dependencies and gene data add to the download and disk usage. Requirements vary with the version and platform. Allow at least 12 GB of free disk space. Downloads can take several minutes.

ParaScape gets its own environment at {path}; spaCR's packages are not changed. The source is MIT licensed. A local Git checkout is an optional development source; local installs use committed files and leave the checkout untouched.
records.source:
ParaScape is an alpha application for exploring the Toxoplasma knowledge map. Features and results may change. It opens in a separate window.

The latest compatible stable ParaScape release is installed from PyPI. When gene data is missing, ParaScape asks before downloading it on first open. Dependencies and gene data add to the download and disk usage. Requirements vary with the version and platform. Allow at least 12 GB of free disk space. Downloads can take several minutes.

ParaScape gets its own environment at {path}; spaCR's packages are not changed. The source is MIT licensed. A local Git checkout is an optional development source; local installs use committed files and leave the checkout untouched.
records.translation:
ParaScape er alfa-forrit til að kanna þekkingarkort Toxoplasma. Eiginleikar og niðurstöður geta breyst. Það opnast í sérstökum glugga.

Nýjasta samhæfa stöðuga útgáfan af ParaScape er sett upp frá PyPI. Þegar genagögn vantar biður ParaScape um leyfi áður en þeim er hlaðið niður við fyrstu opnun. Háðir hugbúnaðarpakkar og genagögn auka niðurhal og notkun á diskplássi. Kröfur eru mismunandi eftir útgáfu og stýrikerfi. Gerðu ráð fyrir að minnsta kosti 12 GB af lausu diskplássi. Niðurhal getur tekið nokkrar mínútur.

ParaScape fær sitt eigið umhverfi á {path}; pökkum spaCR er ekki breytt. Frumkóðinn er með MIT-leyfi. Staðbundin Git-vinnumappa er valfrjáls frumkóðaheimild fyrir þróun; staðbundnar uppsetningar nota skráðar skrár og skilja vinnumöppuna eftir óbreytta.

records.key: Plan conditions, controls and sample sizes using stated assumptions or pilot measurements.
records.source: Plan conditions, controls and sample sizes using stated assumptions or pilot measurements.
records.translation: Skipuleggðu skilyrði, viðmið og úrtaksstærðir út frá tilgreindum forsendum eða forprófunarmælingum.

records.key: Plot measurements, compare experimental conditions or fit dose-response relationships with explicit metadata.
records.source: Plot measurements, compare experimental conditions or fit dose-response relationships with explicit metadata.
records.translation: Teiknaðu mælingar, berðu saman tilraunaskilyrði eða aðlagaðu skammtasvörunarsambönd með skýrum lýsigögnum.

records.key: Prepare image files by importing, converting, correcting illumination or aligning tiles before analysis.
records.source: Prepare image files by importing, converting, correcting illumination or aligning tiles before analysis.
records.translation: Undirbúðu myndskrár með innflutningi, umbreytingu, leiðréttingu lýsingar eða samstillingu myndflísa fyrir greiningu.

records.key: Prepare object images and reviewed labels from raw images before training and evaluating an image classifier.
records.source: Prepare object images and reviewed labels from raw images before training and evaluating an image classifier.
records.translation: Undirbúðu myndir hluta og yfirfarnar flokkamerkingar úr hráum myndum áður en myndflokkari er þjálfaður og metinn.

records.key: Process many microscope images, fields or wells with consistent batch segmentation settings.
records.source: Process many microscope images, fields or wells with consistent batch segmentation settings.
records.translation: Vinndu margar smásjármyndir, myndsvið eða brunna með samræmdum stillingum fyrir hlutun í lotu.

records.key: Review a three-dimensional image and compatible label volume before measuring with the correct voxel spacing.
records.source: Review a three-dimensional image and compatible label volume before measuring with the correct voxel spacing.
records.translation: Farðu yfir þrívíða mynd og samhæft merkjarúmmál áður en mælt er með réttu bili milli rúmpunkta.

records.key: Review how image files map to plates, wells and fields before processing them.
records.source: Review how image files map to plates, wells and fields before processing them.
records.translation: Farðu yfir hvernig myndskrár tengjast plötum, brunnum og myndsviðum áður en þær eru unnar.

records.key: Review image-analysis quality, control behavior and plate effects before interpreting measured differences.
records.source: Review image-analysis quality, control behavior and plate effects before interpreting measured differences.
records.translation: Farðu yfir gæði myndgreiningar, hegðun viðmiða og plötuáhrif áður en mældur munur er túlkaður.

records.key: Review matching frame images and masks before choosing a supported tracking route and calibrated timing.
records.source: Review matching frame images and masks before choosing a supported tracking route and calibrated timing.
records.translation: Farðu yfir samsvarandi myndramma og grímur áður en studd rakningarleið og kvarðaðar tímasetningar eru valdar.

records.key: Review spatial axes and voxel spacing before segmenting and measuring a three-dimensional image.
records.source: Review spatial axes and voxel spacing before segmenting and measuring a three-dimensional image.
records.translation: Farðu yfir rúmása og bil milli rúmpunkta áður en þrívíð mynd er hlutuð og mæld.

records.key: Segment images and measure objects, then compare measurements or explore broader imaging phenotypes.
records.source: Segment images and measure objects, then compare measurements or explore broader imaging phenotypes.
records.translation: Hlutaðu myndir og mældu hluti; berðu síðan saman mælingar eða kannaðu víðara svið myndgreindra svipgerða.

records.key: Segment spatial slides, decode image-based spatial identities or connect those identities to measured phenotypes.
records.source: Segment spatial slides, decode image-based spatial identities or connect those identities to measured phenotypes.
records.translation: Hlutaðu myndir af sýnisglerjum fyrir staðbundna greiningu, afkóðaðu staðbundin auðkenni úr myndum eða tengdu þau við mældar svipgerðir.

records.key: Start with measurements in a spaCR database or an external table to explore, compare or classify objects.
records.source: Start with measurements in a spaCR database or an external table to explore, compare or classify objects.
records.translation: Byrjaðu á mælingum í spaCR-gagnagrunni eða ytri töflu til að kanna, bera saman eða flokka hluti.

records.key: Start with microscopy images, photographs or figure images that need organization, segmentation or analysis.
records.source: Start with microscopy images, photographs or figure images that need organization, segmentation or analysis.
records.translation: Byrjaðu á smásjármyndum, ljósmyndum eða myndum úr fræðilegum myndum sem þarf að skipuleggja, hluta eða greina.

records.key: Start with sequencing reads to map experimental barcodes and review mapping quality.
records.source: Start with sequencing reads to map experimental barcodes and review mapping quality.
records.translation: Byrjaðu á raðgreiningarlestrum til að varpa strikamerkjum tilraunarinnar og fara yfir gæði vörpunar.

records.key: Train from reviewed image labels, create labels first or apply an existing image-classifier checkpoint.
records.source: Train from reviewed image labels, create labels first or apply an existing image-classifier checkpoint.
records.translation: Þjálfaðu með yfirförnum flokkamerkingum mynda, búðu fyrst til merkingar eða beittu fyrirliggjandi vistuðum myndflokkara.

records.key: Train from reviewed image-mask pairs or refine an existing segmentation checkpoint.
records.source: Train from reviewed image-mask pairs or refine an existing segmentation checkpoint.
records.translation: Þjálfaðu með yfirförnum mynd- og grímupörum eða fínstilltu fyrirliggjandi vistaðan hlutunarlíkanspunkt.

records.key: Upgrade ParaScape through pip from PyPI in its separate environment at {path}. Close any running ParaScape windows before upgrading. ParaScape is in alpha; downloads and disk usage depend on the release. When the new release needs gene data, ParaScape asks before downloading it on first open. spaCR's packages are not changed.
records.source: Upgrade ParaScape through pip from PyPI in its separate environment at {path}. Close any running ParaScape windows before upgrading. ParaScape is in alpha; downloads and disk usage depend on the release. When the new release needs gene data, ParaScape asks before downloading it on first open. spaCR's packages are not changed.
records.translation: Uppfærðu ParaScape með pip frá PyPI í sérstöku umhverfi þess á {path}. Lokaðu öllum opnum ParaScape-gluggum fyrir uppfærslu. ParaScape er á alfastigi; niðurhal og notkun diskpláss fer eftir útgáfu. Þegar nýja útgáfan þarf genagögn biður ParaScape um leyfi áður en þeim er hlaðið niður við fyrstu opnun. Pökkum spaCR er ekki breytt.

records.key: Use an existing classifier and compatible inputs to predict object classes, evaluate results or explain scores.
records.source: Use an existing classifier and compatible inputs to predict object classes, evaluate results or explain scores.
records.translation: Notaðu fyrirliggjandi flokkara og samhæf inntaksgögn til að spá fyrir um flokka hluta, meta niðurstöður eða skýra stig.

records.key: Use existing measurements for a dedicated assay after checking its compartment, identity and channel requirements.
records.source: Use existing measurements for a dedicated assay after checking its compartment, identity and channel requirements.
records.translation: Notaðu fyrirliggjandi mælingar fyrir tiltekið greiningarpróf eftir að kröfur þess um hólf, auðkenni og rásir hafa verið athugaðar.

records.key: Use explicitly joined screening inputs for regression or connect saved hits to object-level measurements.
records.source: Use explicitly joined screening inputs for regression or connect saved hits to object-level measurements.
records.translation: Notaðu sérstaklega samtengd skimunarinntök fyrir aðhvarf eða tengdu vistaðar skimunarniðurstöður við mælingar einstakra hluta.

records.key: Use mapped barcode counts with experimental identities for quality checks or screening regression.
records.source: Use mapped barcode counts with experimental identities for quality checks or screening regression.
records.translation: Notaðu varpaðar talningar strikamerkja með tilraunaauðkennum fyrir gæðaeftirlit eða skimunaraðhvarf.

records.key: Use matching source images and integer object masks, or an existing merged spaCR project.
records.source: Use matching source images and integer object masks, or an existing merged spaCR project.
records.translation: Notaðu samsvarandi upprunamyndir og hlutagrímur með heiltölumerkjum eða fyrirliggjandi sameinað spaCR-verkefni.

records.key: Use or choose a segmentation checkpoint to generate masks, train or compare models.
records.source: Use or choose a segmentation checkpoint to generate masks, train or compare models.
records.translation: Notaðu eða veldu vistaðan hlutunarlíkanspunkt til að búa til grímur, þjálfa eða bera saman líkön.

records.key: Use per-object image crops for labeling, image-based phenotype exploration or image classification.
records.source: Use per-object image crops for labeling, image-based phenotype exploration or image classification.
records.translation: Notaðu myndútskurði einstakra hluta fyrir flokkamerkingu, könnun myndgreindra svipgerða eða myndflokkun.

records.key: Use reviewed image-mask pairs to train, refine or independently evaluate segmentation models.
records.source: Use reviewed image-mask pairs to train, refine or independently evaluate segmentation models.
records.translation: Notaðu yfirfarin mynd- og grímupör til að þjálfa, fínstilla eða meta hlutunarlíkön á óháðan hátt.

records.key: Use saved screening-regression outputs to inspect diagnostics, prioritize hits or compare analyses.
records.source: Use saved screening-regression outputs to inspect diagnostics, prioritize hits or compare analyses.
records.translation: Notaðu vistaðar niðurstöður skimunaraðhvarfs til að skoða greiningarpróf, forgangsraða skimunarniðurstöðum eða bera saman greiningar.

records.key: Work with a smaller image set to create, correct and review masks interactively.
records.source: Work with a smaller image set to create, correct and review masks interactively.
records.translation: Vinndu með minna myndasafn til að búa til, leiðrétta og yfirfara grímur gagnvirkt.
